body:
Formality is allowed, but discouraged.

The weather: this is the good time of year. A normal February 20 in Naples tops out around 78°F and settles into the mid to upper 50s overnight. It is the dry season, so rain is unlikely.

What to expect: the whole wedding is outside. The party starts at 3 PM, and the afternoon is usually warm and sunny, so dress light and bring sunglasses. The event officially ends at sunset, 6:23 PM, but the party goes on for as long as people are standing. It cools into the 60s after dark, so bring a light layer if you plan to be one of them.

Footwear: the party is in the front and back yard, so you will be on grass and pavers. Wear shoes that can handle both.

Every so often a cold front comes through and February forgets it is Florida. Check the forecast the week before.
